title: Apache Sourcelume Training Provenance Record (0.0.1)
description: Structural schema for a Sourcelume TrainingProvenanceRecord: a model producer's claim of which datasets a model was trained on. Datasets are referenced by IRI (typically the `id` of a ProvenanceRecord); their provenance is not repeated here. No signature block yet.

@context.description: Only the canonical context IRI is accepted. Inline @context objects and any other IRI are rejected, so a record's meaning is fixed by the published context.

identifier.description: Identifier for the model being described (e.g. a DOI or persistent URL), not for this record.

version.description: Model version or checkpoint, if versioned.

creator.description: The party or parties that produced the model and make this claim.

role.description: Optional. Same meaning as in ProvenanceRecord, applied to the model.

created.description: When this training provenance record was authored (record metadata, not a training date).

disclosure.description: How much of the training data the producer discloses in `trainingData`. 'complete': every training dataset is listed. 'partial': only some are listed. 'undisclosed': the producer does not disclose its training data; `trainingData` may then be omitted. This is the producer's own statement about its disclosure, not a judgement by Sourcelume.

trainingData.description: The datasets the model was trained on, in no particular order. Required unless `disclosure` is 'undisclosed'.

dataset.description: IRI of the dataset. Normally the `id` of a Sourcelume ProvenanceRecord, so its provenance can be resolved. May also be any other dataset IRI (for example a repository page) when no record exists.

phase.description: Optional. Training phase in which the dataset was used. Omit when the producer does not distinguish phases. 'fine-tuning' covers instruction, SFT and retrieval-grounding stages; 'evaluation' is for held-out sets the model was tested on, not trained on.

tokens.description: Optional. Number of tokens drawn from the dataset (per epoch, or in total; say which in `note`).

share.description: Optional. Fraction of the phase's training tokens that came from this dataset, between 0 and 1.

note.description: Optional. Free-text qualifier for the claim, e.g. where the full list is published, or whether `tokens` are per epoch or in total.
